scope: One cached-report comparison; exposed REG 2022-2024; no fitting or inference
annual_diagnostics: Three supporting annual views per registered pooled contrast; all years retained; no annual selection

uncertainty.procedure: Reuse V2 paired whole-season-week and whole-game resampling; pooled and annual descriptive intervals

source_compatibility: Require completed V2 and its all-97-feature exact equivalence to the direct screen's same accepted source identity before decoding values; same category contract and 2022-2024 primary-role offered keys, context, cutoffs and outcomes
point_semantics: Use literal saved direct points unchanged. Frozen direct source explicitly uses prior.mean on count fallbacks. Verify stored mean-objective/median-objective/event semantics, report fallback counts and losses, never convert a point into a predictive law
binary_recovery: Only the two XGBoost anytime-TD settings use separately authenticated direct_xgboost_binary_canonical_v2_{small,medium} scored derivatives. Their original direct-screen slots stay FAILED. No derivative missingness or identity mismatch is filled with a donor or another method
anytime_response_candidate: Exact fresh leaf-CDF alias, zero new fit; preserve alias identity in every comparison
cohort: All primary-role offers retained. Exact one-to-one keys/context/cutoffs/actuals/participation required before comparison; mismatches retained as unavailable, never favorable intersections. Played zero, unknown, DNP, missing and invalid labels distinct
eligibility: Best-observed descriptive eligibility requires all three annual cells, identical supported and forecast masks, and complete offered forecast coverage. Keep all six settings and all failed/unavailable cells. No tuning, nomination, SITE/R0 claim, scientific qualification or deployment
publication: Aggregate metrics/status/procedure identities and safe hashes only; no private paths, individual player/game rows, model weights or expanded internal ledger

technical_continuation.repair: Accepted process_free_threads helper, exact hash-bound already-mapped libc, only name c; retain strict child/network/model guards and private failure stacks
